name: strata-chain-v100-4x
description: Checkpoint chain on four V100-32G cards (IQ3_S fully resident), 1k -> 100k -> 200k -> 262144, 512 tokens per turn. Run 2026-10-27 against the L40 chain.

estimate.basis: not measured; one 4x V100 allocation plus staging/load; the chain itself is four prefills and 4 x 512-token decode

caveats: Run 2026-10-27 (job 38246490): reuse is checkpoint-limited exactly like the L40 (98,304 at 200k, 196,608 at 262k, full 261,671 on the top repeat); V100 TTFT is 1.2-1.7x the L40 at the growth turns and 8x on the repeat.
One allocation must own all four cards; IQ3_S must be fully resident (verify the engine log, do not assume).
Four V100 cards are layer-split, not tensor-parallel; the conversation-cache budget and checkpoint granularity may differ from the L40 run.
The chain is C1 and sequential; it does not exercise the multi-slot resident scheduler.
Each stop is clamped to 262144 - 512 - 128 = 261504 prompt tokens.
Check `squeue -u holecem` first: the V100 campaign may own volta05.
